description: Source code for handling data-ready trigger interrupts in the WSEN HIDS sensor driver, including setup, callback handling, and thread management.

methods.name: hids_setup_drdy_interrupt
methods.description: Configures the data-ready GPIO interrupt on the device.

methods.name: hids_handle_drdy_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data-ready interrupt, disables further interrupts, and signals processing.

methods.name: hids_process_drdy_interrupt
methods.description: Invokes the data ready handler if set and re-enables the interrupt.

methods.name: hids_trigger_set
methods.description: Sets the trigger handler for data-ready events and manages interrupt configuration.

methods.name: hids_drdy_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback invoked on data-ready GPIO event, triggers processing.

methods.name: hids_thread
methods.description: Dedicated thread function for handling data-ready events when configured with own thread.

methods.name: hids_work_cb
methods.description: Workqueue callback for handling data-ready events when using global thread.

methods.name: hids_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for data-ready signal, sets up callback and enables interrupt.
